applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Interest Rate on Deposits) Third Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Update deposit interest rate ceilings and relaxations for FCNR(B) and NRE deposits to end on August 31, 2026 instead of September 30, 2026.
answer.action_quote: it has been decided to amend the date ‘September 30, 2026’ to the date ‘August 31, 2026’ for the aforementioned temporary relaxation.

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Interest Rate on Deposits) Directions, 2025
